channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: At Albuquerque's Indian Pueblo Kitchen, Native American dishes are the main course
item.description: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.

item.title: Court lets Puerto Rico governor fire firm that runs the island's troubled power grid
item.description: LUMA Energy took over the electric grid five years ago. The court's ruling nullifies its contract, and gives the government a year to find a new operator.

item.title: More people searched for news during the midterms, survey finds
item.description: Most Americans sought out information about the results of the midterm elections. A Pew study found that younger and older adults turned to very different sources.

item.title: Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed
item.description: Extreme weather that has unleashed strong winds, high tides, heavy rain and floods is expected to impact travel plans of an estimated 81.5 million people as they travel across the United States.
